title: Beliefs, Attitudes, and Interest in Genetic Testing in Sarcoma Patients
official: Beliefs, Attitudes, and Interest in Genetic Testing in Sarcoma Patients
summary: Genomic research has shown that a portion of leiomyosarcomas can be attributed to an underlying cancer predisposition syndrome. However, the optimal approach for incorporating germline testing into the care of these patients is not yet established. This study will assess beliefs about the heritability of leiomyosarcoma (LMS) and other cancers, and attitudes toward germline testing among LMS patients.
criteria:
Inclusion

* Living
* Able to speak and read English or Spanish
* Mentally competent
* Age 18 or older

Exclusion

* \<18 years
* Unable to read or write

sites.f: Huntsman Cancer Institute at the University of Utah
